# EZYOURLIFE

> The Future's First AI App Store — a simple, pay-as-you-go AI platform with 200+ live AI tools today and 2,000+ launching within a year. No subscriptions, just credits (packs from ₹10).

EZYOURLIFE is a unified AI app store where users discover, run, and pay only for the AI tools they actually use. Tools cover images, video, writing, productivity, education, marketing, business analysis, and more. Authentication, credits, and a shared workspace let users move seamlessly between tools.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page with featured tools, categories, and how credits work.
- [AI Apps catalog](/ai-apps): Browse and search 200+ live AI tools by sector, department, and user type.
- [About](/about): What EZYOURLIFE is, the team, and contact details.
- [Credits & pricing](/credits): Pay-as-you-go credit packs from ₹10 to ₹1000.
- [Refund policy](/refund-policy): Terms for credit purchases.

## Featured native tools

- [Startup Analyser](/startup-analyser): VC-style startup report generator from a pitch deck or website.
- [Speedy Notebook](/notebook): Rich-text workspace with syncable AI shortcuts.
- [PromptMaster AI](/promptmaster): Build, organize, and sync reusable AI prompts.
- [Meet Nudge](/meet-nudge): Networking and contact follow-up assistant for events.
- [Virasat](/virasat): Generate a family-history book from voice or written input.
- [ProductVision 360](/tools/productvision-360): Multi-angle product photography studio.

- [Mobile shortcuts](/mobile-shortcuts): iOS and Android setup for AI text expansion.
